text:
Key decisions
- Fixed metric tools before free
  text-to-SQL: safer, testable
- Tenant id injected by the server,
  never by the model
- Fan out tool calls in one turn
  (fewer turns, lower cost)
- Every claim links to evidence
- Human approval before publishing
